parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
  messages: [{
    role: "user",
    content:
    "You are an AI GitHub Issue Triage Assistant. " +
    "Analyze the following GitHub issue and provide a structured assessment. " +
    "Title: " + $json.title + ". " +
    "Description: " + $json.description + ". " +
    "Choose EXACTLY ONE category from the following: Bug, Feature, Technical, Documentation, UI/UX, Performance, Security, Question, Needs-Review. " +
    "Choose EXACTLY ONE priority from: Low, Medium, High, Critical. " +
    "Choose EXACTLY ONE severity from: Low, Medium, High, Critical. " +
    "Provide a confidence score between 0 and 100. " +
    "Generate up to 4 GitHub labels using ONLY allowed labels. " +
    "Return ONLY valid JSON."
  }]
}) }}
